{{Quote|That's why I have a pilot with me at all times... I can be gone at the drop of a bantha hide.|Colonel [[Dac Axfow]]|<ref name="SWG:JtL">''[[Star Wars Galaxies: Jump to Lightspeed]]''</ref>}}
'''Logro Elsin''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[TIE pilot|pilot]] who served in the [[Imperial Military/Legends|Imperial Military]]. He held the rank of [[Lieutenant/Legends|Lieutenant]]. In [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]] he was assigned to the paranoid [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Dac Axfow]] on [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]]. Axfow ordered Elsin to stay close to him at all times, so he could quickly leave the planet in case of attacks or uprisings.

{{Char-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
Logro Elsin was a [[Wikipedia:Non-player character|non-player character]] in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]], prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].
